tools.name: search_events
tools.description: Find upcoming events (concerts, live music, theatre, opera, stand-up comedy, festivals, sports, kids & family, exhibitions) in Turkey and selected cities abroad, optionally matched to how the user feels. Returns up to 20 events with title, local date/time, venue, city, category, lowest known ticket

tools.name: get_event
tools.description: Get details of one WhatsMood event by its numeric id (from search_events or a whatsmood.com/etkinlik/...-<id> URL): title, status, local start time, venue and address, city, coordinates, short description, lowest price, event page URL and calendar (.ics) link. TR: Etkinlik ayrıntısı.

tools.name: compare_ticket_prices
tools.description: Compare ticket prices for one event across official sellers (Biletix, Biletinial, Bubilet and partners): price, currency, category, availability (in_stock, limited, sold_out), cheapest flag and a buy link. Use when the user asks 'how much are tickets', 'cheapest ticket', 'is it sold out'. TR: Bilet

tools.name: find_nearby_places
tools.description: Find the nearest places of a type in or around a neighbourhood / district (OpenStreetMap data). Prefer a neighbourhood/district name; precise GPS coordinates are not required (if latitude/longitude are given they are rounded to ~1 km on the server). Types: pharmacy, hospital, cafe, restaurant, lodgi

tools.name: list_campaigns
tools.description: Only call when the user explicitly asks for deals, discounts, offers or campaigns; do not suggest campaigns otherwise. Lists active campaigns that venues and brands publish on WhatsMood Business, by city, neighbourhood or mood: business name, offer, description, end date, distance. These are SPONSOR

tools.name: list_moods
tools.description: List the moods WhatsMood understands (Turkish name + English equivalent, e.g. Mutlu = happy, Üzgün = sad) and the event categories. Call this when unsure which mood value to pass to search_events. TR: Modlar ve kategoriler.

tools.name: list_cities
tools.description: List cities that currently have upcoming events on WhatsMood (most events first) with their city page URL. TR: Etkinliği olan şehirler.

tools.name: search_public_lists
tools.description: Search published, curated lists on WhatsMood (e.g. 'Best jazz nights in Istanbul', 'Rainy day ideas in Ankara') made by WhatsMood editors and the community: name, description, city, mood, item count and list URL. TR: Herkese açık hazır listeler.

tools.name: get_public_list
tools.description: Get the items (events, venues, films, music, places) of one published WhatsMood list by id, each with its page URL. TR: Liste içeriği.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_events, get_event, list_cities, search_public_lists, get_public_list · Public sink: list_campaigns.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_events, get_event, list_cities, search_public_lists, get_public_list · Public sink: list_campaigns

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
